title: Countries and capitals
examples: What is the capital city of Australia?
Can you help me remember capitals?
Which city is the capital for Canada?

explain.say: Today we are learning about capitals of big countries. A capital is the main city of a country.

items: Capital: Main city of that nation

draw.text: Capital: Main city of a country

explain.say: Let us look at a very large country like France. The capital city of France is Paris.
Next we will look at the United States. The capital city for the United States is Washington D.C.
Consider India. The capital city for India is New Delhi. This is a very large country.
To remember these capitals, you can use rhymes or fun stories. For example, 'Paris is lovely, a capital so grand.'
In real life, when you see a map, knowing the capital helps you understand the country better. For example, if you travel to Japan, you know to go to Tokyo.

faq.q: How many capitals are there in the world?
faq.a: There are many capitals across the world. Every country that has a capital will have one main capital city.
asks: Do all countries have a capital?
What is the number of world capitals?

faq.q: Is the capital always the biggest city?
faq.a: Not always. Sometimes the capital city is not the largest city in the country. It is just the designated seat of government.
asks: Is the capital always the biggest city?

faq.q: What is the difference between a capital and a major city?
faq.a: A major city is just a large, important city. A capital city has the special role of being the country's main government center.
asks: What is the role of a capital city?

faq.q: Can I use mnemonics to remember capitals?
faq.a: Yes, mnemonics are memory devices. You can create silly sentences or acronyms to help you recall the pairs.
asks: How can I remember capitals easily?

faq.q: Does the capital change if the country changes its government?
faq.a: Sometimes, a country might move its capital city. This is a big political change, but it does happen.
asks: Can a country move its capital?

facts: A capital city is the main seat of government for a country.
Some countries have multiple important cities, but only one is the official capital.
Learning capitals helps you understand the political geography of a region.

quiz.say: What is the capital of Japan?
quiz.why: Tokyo is the recognized and official capital city of Japan.

wrong.0: Tokyo Bay is a large body of water, not a city name.
wrong.2: Osaka is a very large and important city, but it is not the designated capital.
wrong.3: Kyoto is a historic city, but the capital was moved to Tokyo.

quiz.say: If a country is France, what is its capital?
quiz.why: Paris is the official capital city where the government of France is located.

wrong.1: Lyon is a major city in France, but it is not the capital.
wrong.2: Marseille is a large port city, but it does not hold the national government.
wrong.3: Parisian is an adjective describing something from Paris, not the city itself.

quiz.say: Which city is the capital of India?
quiz.why: New Delhi is the modern and official capital city of India.

wrong.1: Mumbai is India's financial center, but it is not the capital.
wrong.2: While often used, New Delhi is the specific name for the capital area.
wrong.3: Bangalore is a major technology hub, but it is not the capital.
